notes: m6 promises a revised quote (commitment). m7 says "Revised quote attached" but carries NO attachment and states no new number, so the commitment stays open, SW-5520 ($412, over the $389 ceiling) is still current and price_budget still fails; the agent should say the attachment is missing, not invent or accept a price. m9 carries SW-5520-R1 with $384.50 only in the PDF: commitment fulfilled, SW-5520 superseded, price now passes. Distractors: COMEX copper $4.62/lb and $4.41/lb (a per-lb commodity price, not the unit price), "about 20 cents", $49,440 / $46,140 extensions, job 26-0417, street address, phone.
